comments.author: @LumaTravel99
comments.text: We call these places “impossible” and “deadly,” yet millions of people call them home. 🌍 Maybe the real question isn’t why they stay, but why the rest of the world assumes everyone has the same choices. Are these people incredibly brave, or have we become too comfortable to understand their reality? 🤔 What do you think?
